sections.Profile:
Bali-Hi is an electro-mechanical pinball machine produced by Bally Manufacturing Co. and released in September 1970. Designed by Ted Zale with artwork by Christian Marche, this 4-player machine features two flippers, four pop bumpers, three kick-out holes, and standup targets. It is themed around world places, capturing the tropical essence of Bali.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Travel, Original Theme, 1970s
